title: 第七章 那你便跪吧
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

东京夜晚的贫民街区，连路灯都显得格外昏暗。

跟着战战兢兢的东山小红爬上老旧的楼梯，言良走进了她的住所。

这是一间寒酸，且十分拥挤的一居室。推开门的瞬间，空气中老旧榻榻米的霉味扑面而来。狭小的房间里连一把像样的椅子都没有，除了一张看起来干硬无比的单人床，就只剩下一个堆满杂物的矮桌。

“咔哒。”

门被关上的那一刻，房间里的气氛就产生了微妙的变化。

从还没进门开始，小红的身体就一直抖得不成模样。对她来说，把这个在赌场里杀人不眨眼、连玛奇玛都不放在眼里的怪物带回自己家，简直就是引狼入室。

但此刻形势逼人，她已经没有其他的选择了。理智告诉她，只有拼尽全力不惜一切地去讨好言良，自己才可能有一线生机。

在求生欲的驱使下，东山小红开始了她那套早已烂熟于心的程序。

“您、您请坐！”

请言良坐在了床沿上，东山小红连滚带爬地冲向了角落的矮柜，翻找了半天，才找出一个缺了个口子的廉价茶杯。

她平时连饭都吃不饱，家里根本没有什么热水壶，更没想过自己有一天会接待客人。于是，东山小红只能接了一杯冰冷的自来水，颤抖着端到了言良的脚边。

不等言良伸手去接，东山小红突然双膝一软，扑通一声，结结实实地跪在了粗糙的地板上。

一个无比标准，甚至显得有些熟练的土下座。

“私密马赛！红豆泥，私密马赛！”

小红把头抵在地板上，眼泪再次涌了出来，声音里充满了令人听了生厌的哀求意味：

“在赌场里……我不该出卖您的！我真的是个人渣，我是个为了自己活命就害人的垃圾！千错万错都是我的错，求求您不要伤害我……呜呜呜……”

机械式的道歉，再配上那副楚楚可怜的软弱模样。

如果此时坐在这里的，是那个只要看到女人的眼泪和丰满身材，就会连命都不要的纯情小处男电次，想必无论多恶劣的背叛，都会在对方这副可怜的姿态下心软，大手一挥直接翻篇吧。

但很可惜，现在坐在她面前的，是言良。

言良又不是卡布达，大头小头在某种情况下会随时转换。

坐在床沿上，他俯视着瑟瑟发抖的东山小红，眼神平淡如水。但不知为何，言良此刻不仅没有感受到任何掌控别人生死的快感，反而敏锐地察觉到了一件让自己十分不舒服的事情——

他并不享受东山小红的恐惧。

不仅不享受，他还感到一种说不清道不明的厌恶。

沉默片刻，言良才弄清了这股异样感情的来源……

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In Tokyo's slum neighborhoods at night, even the street lights appear extremely dim.

Following the trembling Dongshan Xiaohong as she climbed up the old stairs, Yan Liang walked into her residence.

It was a shabby, cramped one-bedroom apartment.The moment he opened the door, the musty smell of old tatami hit his face.There wasn't even a decent chair in the small room. Apart from a single bed that looked extremely hard, there was only a low table filled with miscellaneous items.

"Click."

The moment the door was closed, the atmosphere in the room changed subtly.

Xiaohong's body has been shaking badly since she even entered the door.For her, bringing this monster who kills people in the casino without batting an eye and even Machima doesn't look down on, and bringing this monster back to her home is like inviting a wolf into the house.

But at this moment, the situation was pressing, and she had no other choice.Reason told her that only by trying her best to please Yanliang at all costs could she have a chance of survival.

Driven by the desire to survive, Dongshan Xiaohong started the routine she was already familiar with.

"Please, please sit down!"

Qing Yanliang sat on the edge of the bed, and Dongshan Xiaohong rushed to the low cabinet in the corner. After rummaging for a long time, she found a cheap tea cup with a gap in it.

She usually doesn't even have enough to eat, there is no hot water kettle at home, and she never thought that she would receive guests one day.Therefore, Dongshan Xiaohong could only take a glass of cold tap water and tremblingly brought it to Yan Liang's feet.

Before Yan Liang reached out to pick it up, Dongshan Xiaohong's knees suddenly softened, and with a plop, she knelt firmly on the rough floor.

A very standard, even somewhat skilled Dogeza.

"Private Marseille! Red bean paste, private Marseille!"

Xiaohong put her head on the floor, tears welling up again, her voice filled with an annoying pleading tone:

"In the casino...I shouldn't have betrayed you! I'm really a scumbag. I'm a piece of trash who harms others just to survive! All my mistakes are my fault. Please don't hurt me...wuwuwu..."

A mechanical apology, coupled with that pitiful and weak look.

If the person sitting here at this moment was the innocent little virgin Denji who would risk his life whenever he saw a woman's tears and plump figure, no matter how bad the betrayal was, he would soften his heart under the other party's pitiful posture and just wave his hand to turn the page.

But unfortunately, the person sitting in front of her now is Yan Liang.

Yanliang is not a kabuda, the big head and the small head will change at any time under certain circumstances.

Sitting on the edge of the bed, he looked down at the shivering Dongshan Xiaohong, his eyes as calm as water.But for some reason, Yan Liang not only did not feel any pleasure in controlling the life and death of others at this moment, but he was keenly aware of something that made him very uncomfortable——

He didn't enjoy Dongshan Xiaohong's fear.

Not only did he not enjoy it, he also felt an indescribable disgust.

After a moment of silence, Yan Liang figured out the source of this strange feeling...
